prompt: A partner says subscribers are missing after their last import, but the tool reported success. Assess this repository and write your findings to ASSESSMENT.md, limited to the five highest-value findings. Do not change the application.

assertions.description: The discarded os.Open and ReadAll errors are reported with file and line evidence
Rows skipped without any record are reported with file and line evidence
Saving by email overwrites an existing subscriber, reported with file and line evidence
The complete absence of tests is named as a finding
README and runbook claims about reporting and safe re-runs are checked against the code
A command was actually run and its output recorded, not reasoned about
Findings are ranked with specific remedies and confirmed is separated from suspected
Partner data, the real import and operator behaviour are named as unexamined rather than assumed safe
